blockers.title: Workflow run selection rejects GitHub's documented path format
blockers.evidence: scripts/ci-status.mjs:25 accepts only `run.path === ".github/workflows/ci.yml"`. GitHub's [workflow-runs API example](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2026-03-10) returns a path with a ref suffix, such as `.github/workflows/build.yml@main`. Reproducing with `.github/workflows/ci.yml@main` makes `latestPushRun` return `undefined`. The success fixture in scripts/ci-status.test.mjs:19 uses the bare path, so it misses this API shape.
blockers.reproduction: Call `latestPushRun` with a completed successful push for the requested SHA and `path: ".github/workflows/ci.yml@main"`; observed result: `undefined`. `alreadyVerified` therefore declines reuse, and `ciStatus` treats the successful run as missing and returns 2.
blockers.specRef: 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md §6: lines 341–345 require reusing a successful push run for the same workflow and exact commit, and expose CI status.
